column1: # engine-roots.tsv - reachability roots extracted from Dunia.dll (retail Steam build).
# Consumed by `jackall-cli xref reach`. Patterns are .NET regexes matched case-insensitively
# against game-relative corpus paths; they are corpus-matched, never printf-expanded, so a
# format string's iteration domain never has to be re-derived. Provenance comments carry the
# defining Dunia.dll string address and the raw engine string.
#   kind : literal | pattern | world | family | fallback
#   flags: SP, MP, EDITOR and their |-combos; GLOBAL (= SP|MP|EDITOR);
#          WORLD (= derive from the pattern's (?<world>...) capture via the `world` rules);
#          NONE (recorded for the reason string, seeds nothing)
# 10e9f34 "Worlds\tmpla\generated\tmpla.game.xml" - hardcoded, but only plausibly reached via
# -benchmark; the un-stripped development twin of the world slot.
# shader permutation id space; ~93% of shadersobj is unnamed and ids are not paths, so per-file
# evidence cannot exist (see memory of the shadersobj ceiling). Matched on archive source name.
# ---- sound: id-addressed spaces, names composed as hex ids ----
# 10e23b08 "%s\%s\oasisstrings.rml" - the engine composes the .rml; the .xml siblings are
# ---- UI packages (flags from the engine's own sp/mp/ige naming) ----
# 10e288d4 "ui\_depload.xml" - the UI manifest IS the xml here, unlike the worlds twins
# 10eeabb8 "%sFonts%s%s.mft" + page textures the .mft's font names imply
# 10e43134 DemonWareAccountSecureKey.pub - engine\ prefix family already covers them; kept for flags
# graphics\move MOVE graphs: loaded by name, clips resolved through them (MoveReferenceExtractor)
# ---- per-world composed names (WORLD flags via the <world> capture) ----
# 10ea9ed0 "%s%s_depload.dat" - the binary manifest is the primary
# 10e43540 "nv\nv.nvm" - satellites located by convention (descriptor tables ship zeroed)
# ---- fallbacks: engine knows the name but only reads it when the primary is absent ----
# 10e397c0 "_depload.xml" - readable twin of the .dat, read only if the .dat is missing
# 10e8b38c "\entitylibrary_full.fcb" - flag-selected variant; SP takes the suffix-less branch
# Unmatched engine strings deliberately not rooted: profile/system files outside the archives
# DARE.INI 10fa3348), the archive files themselves (patch.dat 10f4872c and the 10f485e0..10f48720
# mount list - they are containers, not entries), format strings too generic to anchor
# ("%s%s\%s.xml" 10e3984c, "%s.dat" 10e39884), and editor-era templates whose files never shipped
